code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    rows={r for r in range(h) if all(v==9 for v in grid[r])}
    cols={c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==9 for r in range(h))}
    return [[2 if v==9 and (r in rows or c in cols) else v for c,v in enumerate(row)] for r,row in enumerate(grid)]
''';open(p,'w').write(code);exec(code);out=transform(grid); print([i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v==9 for v in row)]);print([j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[j]==9 for row in grid)]); print('
'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
